S1_CO_TRANSPORT_STABLE.state: A centred on B (stable-centre pair); A's target xy coincides with where A rides when B reaches its destination
unestablished: A actually rides with B without sliding

S2_SEPARATE_DESTINATIONS.state: A stable on B; A's target is elsewhere
unestablished: any cost of carrier-first beyond path

S3_CO_TRANSPORT_UNSTABLE.state: same goals as S1 but A near the carrier edge (margin 0.010 m)

S4_NO_SUPPORT_NEUTRAL.realised_by: any usable pair with A placed apart
S4_NO_SUPPORT_NEUTRAL.state: A not on B; moving B does not change A
